baseResearchRelease.note: Iteration 2.37 adds 157 exact source-local Roome embryonic refined dIL profiles and all 15,900 Table S7 differential-feature rows, while quarantining 26 non-text gene cells. One atomic research focus now controls the canonical lab, source-locked evidence rail and exact visual target. Every multi-record molecular namespace has a distinct four-row preview, shared gaps are consolidated, and the verified Explorer index is memoized per browser session. Molecular selection clears prior morphology and admits zero geometry or internal objects. No same-cell join, registration, project copy or package copy is added.

scientificBoundaries.micronsObservedReference: The exact cell and nucleus are a visual-cortex cross-region reference. The outer segmentation boundary is not a molecular membrane. No anatomy, type, morphology, organelle, synapse or registration relationship to any spinal record is admitted.
scientificBoundaries.ronzanoPremotorPositions: Every primitive is one exact early-postnatal source coordinate row with no biological radius. Raw and normalized representations remain unpaired, source-local, measurement-forbidden, and unregistered; no soma, morphology, type, synapse, internal structure, adult placement, prevalence or census claim is admitted.
scientificBoundaries.missingEvidence: Missing or unavailable evidence generates zero primitives and is not biological absence.
scientificBoundaries.alkaslasiCholinergicTaxonomy: I1-I8 counts and Cervical, Thoracic, deposited Lumbar, M, F, and NA cross-tabs are exact source-row aggregates. Chat-Cre/Sun1 reporter history and FACS enrichment prohibit prevalence or unbiased-census claims. Sample-region values are not xyz coordinates. The source gzip and per-nucleus roster remain remote and unbundled; no morphology, internal structure, synapse, cross-source identity, or registration is admitted.
scientificBoundaries.grpDorsalHornObservedMorphology: NMO 109021 is an independent GRP::eGFP reporter-positive adult-mouse dorsal-horn source-local reconstruction. Moderate integrity and a 300 micrometre parasagittal slice cannot establish a complete arbor. Twelve original soma contours were averaged into twelve SWC points. The radius derivative is not membrane; no SCI entity, molecular profile, atlas placement, internal structure, synapse, cross-source identity or registration is admitted.
scientificBoundaries.evidenceAware3dRepresentation: Nine evidence states cover sixteen routes. Every route exposes representation authority and exact source receipts. Missing object geometry yields zero primitives; standardized soma points and radius derivatives are not membranes, nuclei or internal structures. Source-native DAT bytes remain non-semantic, paper-level physiology remains unjoined, and procedural biological proxies, cross-source identities and project registrations remain prohibited.
scientificBoundaries.dorsalHornObservedMorphologyRoutePack: The four route-pack records remain independent source-local reconstructions. NMO 104003 and 108974 reuse frozen census identities; NMO 170035 and 249676 are supplementary and do not expand the 142-record census. Co-display, shared markers or shared region labels create no same-cell, molecular-profile, SCI-entity, atlas or registration relationship. Missing diameters, axons, membranes, nuclei, organelles, synapses, receptors and ultrastructure remain explicitly unavailable and never authorize procedural biological geometry.
scientificBoundaries.functionalClassObservedMorphologyRoutePa: NMO 45674 and NMO 50424 remain two independent, source-local, moderate-integrity reconstructions. Their standardized SWC centerlines and recorded radii may support observed skeletons and labelled radius-derived surfaces, but not complete axons, membranes, nuclei, organelles, boutons, synapses or atlas placement. Repository morphometry uses 95-percent principal-component extents and is not equivalent to raw SWC bounds or anatomical axes. The source-native DAT files are unparsed provenance receipts with zero admitted semantic objects. Paper-level physiology has no exact object key. The Renshaw preparation stages and the NPY strain and inverted weight fields remain explicit unresolved context; co-display creates no identity or registration.
scientificBoundaries.prpDorsalHornObservedMorphologyRoutePack: NMO 50394 and NMO 50408 remain independent source-local, moderate-integrity reconstructions. The former is nNOS-positive and the latter galanin-positive; neither positive label establishes the other marker's absence. PrP-promoter reporter wording is not endogenous PrP protein abundance or individual genotype validation. The 300-micrometre source preparation and later 60-micrometre serial resection remain distinct stages without an exact filename crosswalk. Source radii authorize display derivatives, not membranes. Native DAT semantics, exact same-cell physiology, complete axons, same-specimen internal structures, synapses, cross-source identities and registrations remain zero.
scientificBoundaries.premotorComparisonObservedMorphologyRout: NMO 45718 is one independent source-local, moderate-integrity reconstruction labelled by the repository as calbindin-negative, glycinergic, pre-motor and non-renshaw. Because the paper exposes neither the NMO ID nor filename, those labels are not independently verified as an individual calbindin assay, definitive premotor identity, Renshaw exclusion or same-cell physiology; the paper itself notes possible calbindin washout and that non-Renshaw glycinergic cells need not be premotor. The repository's 50-micrometre horizontal field, the paper's 400-micrometre transverse recording slices and 50-micrometre serial resectioning remain distinct. Shrinkage was reported but not corrected, so coordinates are not restored in-vivo dimensions. Eight standardized soma points are not native contour geometry, a membrane, nucleus or volume. Native DAT semantics, complete axons, same-specimen internals, cross-source identities and project registrations remain zero.
scientificBoundaries.supplementaryMorphologyComparisonAdapter: The comparison inventory is exactly 142 immutable census records plus seven supplementary route-local NeuroMorpho records, for 149 viewable source objects; it is not a 149-record census. Each supplementary record retains its own source frame and checksum-pinned route provenance. Seven references reuse existing geometry without copying geometry or SWC files. Independent auto-fit does not establish common scale, orientation, coordinate frame, atlas placement or registration. Repository physical-integrity labels do not establish a complete biological axon. Padding records, same-specimen internals, rendered internal primitives, cross-source identities and registrations remain zero.
scientificBoundaries.sourceFrameDisclosure: The 149 viewable source objects remain exactly 142 frozen census records plus seven supplementary records, never a combined 149-record census. Micrometre scale is computed independently at each viewport camera target from verified source-local coordinates and a viewer-only uniform transform; it does not establish common scale, apparent-size comparability, orientation, a shared coordinate frame, atlas placement or registration. Preparation, raw shrinkage wording and truncation disclosures remain source-grounded. Missing coordinates are not inferred, cut neurites are not repaired, and in-vivo dimensions are not restored. Complete biological axons, same-specimen internal structures, rendered internal primitives, cross-source identities, registrations, project copies and package copies remain zero.
scientificBoundaries.researchExplorerVisualIntegrity: Research Explorer 1.8.0 is a discovery index over 413 independently admitted source records, not a harmonized same-cell or same-type atlas. The 149 morphology records remain 142 frozen census records plus seven supplementary records, never a combined census. Only 13 exact focus identities may enter the main scene; the other 136 exact morphology records stay in the source-specific viewer, while all 264 non-morphology focuses clear stale morphology. Every gap retains a controlled reason code, scope, authority, source locator, raw value, detail and inferenceAllowed=false. Fallback geometry, substitute geometry, same-specimen internal structure, rendered internal primitives, cross-source identity, atlas transforms, registrations, project copies and package copies remain zero.
scientificBoundaries.uiKnowledgeAndTopologyIntegrity: Iteration 2.32 binds visible knowledge to the exact selected source record. A non-SCI focus has no active SCI entity and no borrowed morphology; molecular fingerprints change only source-local facts and expose zero admitted cell geometry. The 149 topology records remain 142 frozen census plus seven supplementary objects in independent source frames. Root, type-1, branchpoint and terminal crosses are deterministic data overlays; type 1 is not a soma contour, terminals are not boutons or synapses, and an absent SWC source type is unavailable rather than biological zero. The topology contract does not create membrane, organelle, internal structure, whole-cell completeness, connectivity, cross-source identity, atlas placement or registration. Project and package copies remain zero.
scientificBoundaries.micronsClippingAndSourceRecordDeltaInteg: Iteration 2.33 adds two display-only operations. The MICrONS plane discards cell-shell fragments only in the shader in the unchanged source-native visual-cortex frame; it never clips the linked nucleus, edits source buffers, generates a cap, repairs or resamples a mesh, or creates measurement, membrane, spinal internal-structure, join or registration claims. The Type Atlas compares exactly 24 explicit display rows with strict string equality; the eight-row I1/I2 receipt is a pinned demonstration subset, not the complete UI whitelist. Exact shared or changed text establishes neither same-cell nor same-type identity and admits no geometry. Project and package copies remain zero.
scientificBoundaries.neuromorphoNoAgeQueryUniverseIntegrity: Iteration 2.34 admits exact repository records and standardized source-local SWCs, not 1,097 biological types, animals, specimens, complete cells or prevalence observations. The frozen 142-record adult subset remains separate even though the full query also contains 142 no-diameter records; those sets overlap but are not identical. Source-labelled 2D coordinates retain source z values without inferred or extruded depth. No Diameter records authorize centerlines only. Missing soma contour, membrane, nucleus, organelles, boutons, synapses, receptors, complete axon, molecular/SCI identity and atlas registration remain unavailable rather than synthesized.
scientificBoundaries.crozatPkd2l1FunctionalProfileIntegrity: Iteration 2.35 creates one source-local PKD2L1-positive CSF-contacting-neuron functional profile, not tonic, single-spike, segment or quadrant cell types. Anatomy, firing-pattern, passive-property and RMP rows retain their own experiment-family denominators and are not summed or globally joined. Four source conflicts remain quarantined. The Figshare release supplies no stable global cell ID, raw ABF trace, raw microscopy, SWC, reconstructable morphology, atlas transform, segmentation, mesh or same-cell link to the separate PKD2L1 SBF-SEM publication. Missing cell geometry and internal detail remain unavailable rather than borrowed, averaged, procedurally generated or inferred from population evidence.
scientificBoundaries.dmrt3Di6AndRecordUiIntegrity: Iteration 2.36 admits six source-local M1-M6 group summaries from the E14.5 Dmrt3-lineage dI6 analysis, not six adult canonical types, per-animal replicates or single-cell identities. Three embryos were pooled into one tube and one library. The 384 deposited wells, 354 QC-retained cells and 274 retained dI6-lineage cells are successive denominators; M1-M6 counts 84, 34, 33, 45, 54 and 24 sum to 274. The source does not export a per-well M-group roster or scalar pseudotime, so neither is reconstructed. The primary-article Methods and pinned executed-notebook QC/HVG workflows remain visibly quarantined, with the executed notebook serving only as this derivative's authority. Switching records changes source-specific evidence and result snippets, but cannot create geometry. SCI synthetic anchors are hidden unless the exact selected focus is an SCI entity; the exact current record reports zero same-record internal primitives when no object is admitted. Missing axes remain available in one consolidated disclosure. No morphology, internal structure, atlas transform, registration, same-cell cross-modal join, project copy, package copy or complete-content folder copy is added.
scientificBoundaries.roomeDilAndRecordWorkspaceIntegrity: Iteration 2.37 admits 157 source-local embryonic refined dIL profiles and all 15,900 deposited differential-feature rows, not 157 canonical cross-study cell types or individual cells. Counts and percentages describe captured cells within this study and are not biological prevalence. Twenty-six non-text spreadsheet gene cells remain quarantined without gene-symbol repair. Six positive display features per type are navigation aids, not defining markers. Fifteen biological litter pools and 29 retained technical outputs are distinct denominators. scRNA-seq and Xenium observations are different cells; label transfer creates no same-cell identity. The source supplies no same-cell whole-cell morphology, dendrite, axon, synapse, electrophysiology, organelle, internal structure or deposited 3D transform. Molecular switching changes record-specific evidence while the 3D scene remains correctly empty. Shared gaps appear once, and zero geometry, internal objects, joins, registrations, project copies, package copies or complete-content folder copies are added.
